import sys,json,hashlib,tempfile,inspect,unittest,io,types
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=['.wavefoundry/framework/scripts','.wavefoundry/framework/scripts/tests'];import sqlite_vector_store as s,memory_eval as e,test_memory_eval as tests
out={};root=Path.cwd();fp=json.loads(Path('docs/waves/1yad2 memory-retrieval-quality/evidence/delivery-fingerprint.json').read_text())
out['fingerprints']={str(p):hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len((b:=(root/p).read_bytes()))).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()==h for p,h in fp.items()};assert all(out['fingerprints'].values())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
 p=Path(t);c=s.runtime.connect(p/s.FILENAME);c.execute('CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)');c.execute('INSERT INTO meta VALUES(?,?)',('store_schema_version','8'));c.execute('CREATE TABLE chunks_docs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,path TEXT)');c.execute('CREATE TABLE vectors_docs(chunk_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,embedding BLOB)')
 a="docs/agents/memory/a.md";b="docs/agents/memory/b'--.md";query=[1.]+[0.]*(s.DIMENSIONS-1);second=[.5,.8660254]+[0.]*(s.DIMENSIONS-2)
 with c:
  for n in range(32):
   path=a if n<30 else b if n==30 else 'docs/not-memory.md';vector=second if n==30 else query;c.execute('INSERT INTO chunks_docs VALUES(?,?)',(n,path));c.execute('INSERT INTO vectors_docs VALUES(?,?)',(n,s.pack_vector(vector)))
 c.close();r=s.dense_path_scores(p,'docs',query,[a,b],2);assert list(r['scores'])==[a,b] and r['eligible_chunks']==31 and r['covered_paths']==2 and r['complete'];assert abs(r['scores'][a]-1)<1e-6 and abs(r['scores'][b]-.5)<1e-5
 assert len(s.dense_path_scores(p,'docs',query,[a,b],1)['scores'])==1
 assert not s.dense_path_scores(p,'docs',query,[a,b,'MISSING'],2)['complete']
 for bad in [0,21,True,1.5]:
  try:s.dense_path_scores(p,'docs',query,[a,b],bad)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid limit accepted')
 out['native_sqlite_vec']='31 eligiblechunks/2paths with30dominantduplicates;quotedpath literal;unrelatedexcluded;cosines1/.5;limit1;missingcoverage;invalidlimits all pass'
# Targeted real tests, not whole suite.
names=['test_scoped_sql_groups_before_limit_and_preserves_database','test_curated_diagnostic_is_nonqualifying_and_query_failures_do_not_leak','test_curated_code_only_index_is_unavailable_not_empty_semantic_success']
for name in names:
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([tests.QualificationTests(name)]));assert result.wasSuccessful();out[name]='pass'
# Mutate runtime function in scratch module dictionary; no source file changes.
source=inspect.getsource(s.dense_path_scores);namespace=dict(s.__dict__);exec(source.replace(' GROUP BY c.path',''),namespace);original=s.dense_path_scores;s.dense_path_scores=types.FunctionType(namespace['dense_path_scores'].__code__,s.__dict__,argdefs=original.__defaults__)
try:
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([tests.QualificationTests(names[0])]));assert len(result.failures)>0 and not result.errors;out['remove_group_by_mutant']=f'{len(result.failures)} assertion failure(s),0 errors'
finally:s.dense_path_scores=original
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2));Path('/private/tmp/wf-qa-final-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
